design: One factor at a time, fixed levels and shared defaults across all datasets. 100 questions, seed233, paired question bootstrap. Not full factorial, not independent seeds, not test-based tuning or proof of parameter insensitivity.
cautions: Clipping caps can be inactive; a flat accuracy curve does not prove they are unnecessary. Common positive scaling of alpha/beta preserves ranking when bonus=0, so blend is probed with alpha fixed, plus endpoints; not the historical alpha=1-beta sweep.
timing_policy: Shared GPU elapsed time is diagnostic only, not latency.
